changes.summary: Scope the external applet dependency validator to production applets while preserving canonical SDK source workspace links.

BiChat generation moves to out-of-process execution whenever Redis is configured: send requests enqueue jobs onto the bichat:run:jobs stream and become event-log cursor readers, a RunJobWorker boots in every process that builds the module (consumer-group fan-out, XPENDING/XCLAIM crash handoff, one retry for infrastructure faults), and sends landing behind an active run park on a per-session FIFO with a queued sidebar status instead of failing with ErrActiveRunExists. The generation loop is extracted into a RunExecutor shared by the inline path (still used when Redis is unconfigured or an enqueue fails) and the worker. Also: money accounts return a field-level duplicate account number message instead of a raw SQL unique-violation error, and the client messages tab shows a localized empty state when no messages exist.

Rewrite the BiChat UI from React to Solid on the shared client-host runtime. This is a breaking change for consumers embedding the React chat components: the React surface of modules/bichat/presentation/web is removed and React/ReactDOM leave the production bundle; React is not kept as a second permanent client renderer. Migration guide ships with the release; rollout is coordinated with EAI-UZ/granite#4600.
Export reusable Playwright synchronization, component host contracts and scoped lifecycle/scenario adapters through @iota-uz/sdk/testing.
Preserve environment assertion failures during teardown and rehome deduplicated uploads into their configured storage root.

Add opt-in browser environments, owned scenarios and PostgreSQL clones; expose correlated periodic receipts that reserve manual execution exclusively and await actual completion, and make zero-retry configurations execute once instead of silently doing nothing.
Keep owned process and PostgreSQL lifecycle locks per environment so unrelated slots can start and stop concurrently.
Reject blocked actors for queued BiChat generation and prevent generator failures after an interrupt from emitting success or persisting actionable questions.
Cancel accepted BiChat generation with its worker lifecycle, retain Redis ownership until executor exit, and join bounded terminal bookkeeping without changing HTTP disconnect behavior.
HRM: derive active/former employee status from the resignation date, show it in the employee list and card, add a status filter, and keep the edit form's dates and tax IDs bound to the save form.
Apply configured upload roots in the canonical core UploadService provider so isolated application uploads are stored and served from the same directory.
Fix sdkctl consumer promotion and lock verification to use the SDK Go module path; this changes CLI tooling only, not published SDK runtime APIs.
Finish finite scene animations before parity layout measurement and visual screenshot paint frames.
